nameOrigin: prefix meaning ‘false’ (Sudowoodo is based on petrified wood)
matter that trees are made of

pokedexEntries.go: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

pokedexEntries.si: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

pokedexEntries.cr: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s a SUDOWOODO, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

pokedexEntries.rs: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because the forelegs remain green throughout the year, the POKéMON is easily identified as a fake during the winter.

pokedexEntries.fr: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

pokedexEntries.lg: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

pokedexEntries.em: It mimics a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. But since its forelegs remain green throughout the year, it is easily identified as a fake in the winter.

pokedexEntries.di: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

pokedexEntries.prl: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

pokedexEntries.pt: To avoid being attacked, it does nothing but mimic a tree. It hates water and flees from rain.

pokedexEntries.hg: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

pokedexEntries.ss: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

pokedexEntries.x: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

pokedexEntries.y: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

pokedexEntries.oras: Sudowoodo camouflages itself as a tree to avoid being attacked by enemies. However, because its hands remain green throughout the year, the Pokémon is easily identified as a fake during the winter.

pokedexEntries.su: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.

pokedexEntries.mo: Apparently, the larger the green parts of this Pokémon, the more collectors value it. It’s a particular favorite among elderly people.

pokedexEntries.us: It’s so popular with the elderly that there’s a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

pokedexEntries.um: The result of its holding the same pose all the time is arms that have become supple yet strong.

pokedexEntries.sw: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it’s a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.

pokedexEntries.sh: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

pokedexEntries.bd: Though it looks like a tree, its body is actually more like rock or stone. The Pokémon is very weak to water.

pokedexEntries.shp: It stands along paths pretending to be a tree. If it starts raining, it seems to disappear.

pokedexEntries.la: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo’s extreme aversion to water merits special note.
